newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down four cents to 14.13 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down four cents to 14.13 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell four cents to 14.13 ringgit ($5.63) a kg after selling prompted by a lower close of the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Monday, traders said.
"There was some support at the lower-level, otherwise the price may have slipped further," said a trader.
Initial offers outnumbered bids by 120 tonnes to 67. Final turnover was 90 tonnes compared to 54 on Monday.
Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. The local premium over London narrowed to $65 from $80.
